reviews.title: Ads in Paid Version—REALLY
reviews.text: This has been my go to app for years. I like the simplicity it no frills, does exactly what I need it to do. Now I’m seeing ads at the bottom of the main screen. There have been no significant improvements to this app to warrant ads for those of us who paid for this app. Will the greed train ever end!!!???

reviews.title: Love and use but TIRED
reviews.text: TIRED of resetting my saved sounds EVERY time when I’m paying. Would gladly upgrade STILL because I use this almost daily, but I HATE that I can’t rely on it.

reviews.title: Skip this
reviews.text: Paid for the lifetime premium but still getting ads in the app.

reviews.title: Paid version has ads
reviews.text: Works alright, but the paid version has ads. Ludicrous, getting a refund.

reviews.title: Ads for Paid Version
reviews.text: This app was great for my focus time and getting work done until now. I am getting distracting ads during my Pomodoro sessions when I bought lifetime premium and thought I wouldn’t get ads. What’s the point in purchasing the app? I wouldn’t recommend if you get distracted easily with ads during your focus time.

reviews.title: Ads?
reviews.text: Paid in full from the beginning and supporting this app creator. So disappointed. All of my timer’s pre-set sounds are wiped and I have to reset them every day. Moreover, I’m now getting ads when I already had paid for lifetime to remove ads for good?

reviews.title: Paid $10 to still have ads
reviews.text: Not worth it. The ads are more distracting than the timer and ruins the idea behind using a pomodoro timer for productivity.  Not good for anyone with ADHD.

reviews.title: Not Free
reviews.text: Cannot use app at all without paying

reviews.title: Functional, glitchy
reviews.text: I have the premium version, but it’s kinda sad I purchased just for me not to be able to change pictures for each timer… every time I add a picture it puts the same one for all timers. Would be nice to be discounted or refunded, or an update.

reviews.title: Apple Watch - sounds are locked even though I paid for premium
reviews.text: On the Apple Watch, the sounds are locked behind a pay wall. Which I paid premium and it’s still locked. This is clearly a glitch because I’ve seen several several other people complain about this and it’s disappointing to see that the developer is taking peoples money that has not fixed this yet
